name: Displaced Suulraili Scientist
text: Scientist who fled Suulrai during the Stray Gods Coup; values the craft, can't live at home anymore, seeks a new home or waits for Suulrai to come to its senses.

name: Keyin Druid
text: Surviving gnome of Siddeodru (or a descendant) from Keyindru, the city swollen with gnomes fleeing the fallout of the Stray Gods Coup.

name: Tech-Bootlegger
text: Knows the Suulraili black tech-market: how to get and sell illegal devices and what technology people are likely to have.

name: Technological Purist
text: Suffered at the hands of the Stray Gods; refuses to have rampant technology in their home or on their person; an honest, pure, tough life.
